dedupe_keys.name: coatingdet wind tower coating inspection code

description: The CoatingDet GitHub repository provides Python processing, training, evaluation and quality-control code for inspection images of wind-turbine tower coatings. The README identifies the companion Zenodo data and explains that full-resolution images are tiled locally. Its own LICENSE file says MIT, while the separate image archive is CC BY 4.0. The software can prepare labelled coating images and evaluate a defect detector whose output may inform condition states in a wind-tower digital twin or maintenance-resilience model. It is an image-analysis workflow, not a turbine structural or corrosion simulator. A caveat is that factory coating defects are only a proxy for later asset condition, and the archive contains varied cameras and lighting conditions. A user must test transfer to field inspections before assigning reliability effects. I read the public repository metadata, README and licence file but did not clone the code, install packages, load the 15 GB image archive or run the models.
